events.title: Kenya: #RejectFinanceBill2024 Begins
events.description: Gen Z takes to the streets of Nairobi in historic numbers. The first wave of peaceful protests against the Finance Bill 2024.

events.title: Kenya: Parliament Stormed
events.description: Historic day as protesters breach parliament grounds. RiseGen provides emergency medical support and legal aid to dozens.

events.title: Kenya: Victory - Finance Bill Withdrawn
events.description: Finance Bill 2024 withdrawn by President Ruto. Protests continue for broader accountability. RiseGen expands support network across Kenya.

events.title: Kenya: Occupy Everywhere Movement
events.description: Simultaneous protests in Nairobi, Mombasa, Kisumu, Nakuru, and other major cities demanding continued accountability.

events.title: Tanzania: Independence Day Rising
events.description: Tanzanian Gen Z joins the movement on Independence Day. Demanding accountability, transparency, and youth representation in government. This marks the expansion of the East African youth movement beyond Kenya.

events.title: Tanzania: Arusha Solidarity March
events.description: Arusha youth join the nationwide Independence Day demonstrations in solidarity with Dar es Salaam. Unity across regions for change.

events.title: Tanzania: Mwanza Youth Assembly
events.description: Lake Zone youth gather in Mwanza to stand with their fellow Tanzanians demanding change and accountability.

events.title: Uganda: Movement Planning Begins
events.description: Ugandan youth activists begin organizing and connecting with the East African Gen Z movement. Building networks, training volunteers, and preparing for future action.

events.title: Uganda: Solidarity Day Planned
events.description: Planned solidarity demonstration with Kenyan and Tanzanian youth. Date tentative pending organizational readiness.

news.title: RiseGen Launches Operations in Tanzania
news.summary: RiseGen officially expands to Tanzania ahead of December 9 Independence Day protests. Support teams deployed to Dar es Salaam, Arusha, and Mwanza.
news.content: Following the success of our operations in Kenya, RiseGen is proud to announce our expansion to Tanzania. Our team has established partnerships with local activists and is ready to provide medical, legal, and logistical support for the upcoming December 9 protests.

news.title: Kenya Protest Support: Impact Report
news.summary: Over 2,500 activists supported during Kenya protests. 150+ legal cases handled. Full transparency report now available.
news.content: We're proud to release our full impact report from the Kenya #RejectFinanceBill2024 protests. Your donations helped provide medical care, legal support, and safety supplies to thousands of Gen Z activists.

news.title: December 9: Complete Safety Guide
news.summary: Complete guide for Tanzania December 9 Independence Day protests. Safety tips, meeting points, emergency contacts, and what to bring.
news.content: The December 9 protests are approaching. Here's everything you need to know to stay safe and make your voice heard. Download our safety guide and share with fellow activists.

news.title: Emergency Response Team Training Complete
news.summary: 50 volunteers trained in Tanzania for emergency medical and legal response during upcoming protests.
news.content: Our Tanzania emergency response team is ready. 50 trained volunteers will be stationed across Dar es Salaam, Arusha, and Mwanza on December 9.

news.title: Uganda Activists Join Movement
news.summary: Ugandan youth leaders meet with RiseGen to plan expansion into Uganda. East African unity growing stronger.
news.content: We're excited to announce preliminary discussions with Ugandan youth activists. The East African Gen Z movement continues to grow across borders.

news.title: Legal Aid Fund Reaches $50,000
news.summary: Thanks to generous donors, our legal aid fund has reached $50,000. Ready to support activists facing prosecution.
news.content: Your donations are making a difference. Our legal aid fund is now fully prepared to support any activists who may face legal challenges during the upcoming protests.
